data.title: Unit 8: Heat and light
Heat and temperature
data.text: Click on either True or False for the following sentences.
The faster the molecules move, the hotter the object gets.
The temperature at which water freezes is 100°C.
Heat is a form of energy.
When two things come close together, heat transfers from the cooler one to the hotter one.
Fahrenheit is one of the measuring scales for temperature.

feedback.rank1: Hmm... You can do better than this.
